events.title: Two new bosses in the SOULLOOP demo. Now in 11 languages.
events.summary: {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/46260655/afa84818976245613943665a10c6980f0438e0eb.gif The demo just got heavier. Two new minibosses now guard the ends of floor 0 and floor 1, and the demo speaks 10 more languages. THE BOILER COLOSSUS The new end of floor 0. A walking boiler with a temper. Vent ring: a burst of steam all around him. Jump it. Tesla arcs: lines of current across the floor. Step off them. Slag lob: molten slag rains on orange rings. Walk out. Boiler rush: he charges down a lane. Get out of it. D

events.title: SOULLOOP is in Steam Next Fest. The demo is free.
events.summary: Hi, DrFi here, the solo dev behind SOULLOOP. I'm playing the free demo live right now on this page. Come say hi in the chat. SOULLOOP is a steampunk boomer shooter where the cards you draft rewrite how your gun works. The demo is free for all of Next Fest. What is in the demo: Three floors of a steam-powered tech base, with a giant mech boss at the bottom. A shotgun or a chaingun, each with its own trick. No cooldowns. events.title: The SOULLOOP demo is out now, free
events.summary: The free SOULLOOP demo is live. Grab it from the store page and jump in.What's in the demo: fight down three floors of the Tech Base with the shotgun and the chaingun. After every floor you draft a card, and the cards change how your guns actually fire, not just the numbers. Every gun has a pressure gauge you fill by playing it well, then vent for a big hit. At the bottom, the Baron is waiting.SOULLOOP is also part of Steam Next Fest, October 19-26.If you play it, tell us in the discussions what
